official_rule_cross_check.ordinary_daily_price_limit: 10 percent around the auction reference price at market opening
official_rule_cross_check.false_positive_rejected: A raw-text extraction of the TWSE multi-product table visually associated warrant/other-product cells with common stocks. The explicit TPEx domestic-stock rows and the code boundary matrix confirmed the existing common-stock schedule. No source or result was invalidated.

implementation_findings.finding: Eligible closing signals map only to the next official calendar session; all 432 preserved buys match that mapping.
Share quantities and cash reservations are computed before the current opening bar is read; same-opening sale proceeds and gap savings are not reassigned.
Engine and signal tick functions match the official common-stock grid; all 851 fills and 1,446 non-null signal price fields are legal, and all fills use 1,000-share lots.
The engine conservatively refuses opening buys at the computed limit-up and exits at or through the computed limit-down, but daily OHLCV cannot prove queue priority or partial execution.

The proxy derives ordinary limits from previous close and verified cash-action factors. It lacks an authoritative per-session auction-reference and disposition/special-trading-status history, so exceptional limit regimes cannot be independently verified.

A known dividend payment due on a closed day is credited on the next session after opening orders have been sized. This is conservative but should be explicit in a future registry. It does not affect run 36081668572 because all positive-dividend rows lack payment dates.
Commission and tax are modeled as fractional TWD under frozen rates; broker-specific discounts and invoice-level integer rounding are not reconstructed.
The engine does not reject duplicate action keys itself. The byte-identical v1 corporate-action input has 69 unique symbol/session and symbol/session/kind keys, so the preserved run is unaffected.

conclusion: No new high or blocker execution defect was demonstrated. Run 36081668572 remains an exploratory daily-auction proxy with unchanged metrics, not verified fills, alpha evidence, production eligibility, or deployment approval.
